title: Russia Wants Finland Out of NATO, Report Says. In 1939 It Invaded Finland #shorts
description:
This week a report said Russia is seeking Finland's exit from NATO and a ban on military bases in the Baltic states as part of the Ukraine talks. In 1939 the Soviet Union demanded land and bases from Finland; when Finland refused, the Red Army invaded, starting the Winter War.
